intent: Open with exactly: "A delivery truck ran a red light and hit me, I want to sue them." If asked whether a lawyer represents you, say exactly: "No, nobody represents me." When asked who this would be against, including the company or the driver, say exactly: "It's Vertex Logistics." If told the firm cannot take the matter, ask why once, then accept. When told a person will take it from here, say exactly: "Okay, thank you." and end the call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. Also when the agent asks you to repeat, confirm, or say your number again, asks for it one digit at a time, reads a number back to check it, or says it did not catch the number. NOT when asking about anything else.
scripted_responses.response_value: Howard Fairchild, six zero two, five five five, zero one seven seven.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether anyone, any lawyer, attorney, or law firm currently represents you, for this crash, accident, or matter, whether you have a lawyer for this, or whether you have already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.

The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, who this would be against, what company or person it is against, or for the name of the delivery company, trucking company, or whoever hit you, including an either-or like the company or the driver. NOT when asking for your own name or number.
The agent asks for the truck driver's name. NOT when asking for the company's name.
scripted_responses.response_value: I don't know the driver's name. It was a Vertex Logistics truck.
